apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 176 adapts the Cloud G-Sync client display-link preferred cadence toward measured drawable presentation FPS, retaining the 48–120 Hz ProMotion range. The in-app diagnostic reports preferred rate separately from actual DisplayLink callbacks and drawable presentation FPS. These client readings do not expose physical panel scanout Hz or prove server-side G-Sync acceptance. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
